text: My daily routine is simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work at a computer and take short breaks every two hours. In the afternoon, I go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. Staying consistent helps me feel calm, healthy, and ready for the next day.
